Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Οσιομάρτυρας ο εν Κωνσταντινουπόλει», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Gavriil»

attestations.note: The day is the Meeting of the Lord. His own page on the site carries the name, the date, an icon and the readings appointed for a martyr, and no life and no troparion.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Οσιομάρτυρας ο εν Κωνσταντινουπόλει»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
